hz4.rootCause: backend/src/hazlenz/evidence/shared-evidence-facts.ts built `noExposure` as an alternation whose last two members were the BARE words `nobody` and `no one`, anchored to nothing about exposure, and wrote employeeExposure=false at confidence 0.98 status confirmed. The anchored alternative additionally accepted `using`, so a control denial negated exposure even without the bare-word branch. THE UNDERLYING ERROR: a negative person quantifier is not an assertion about exposure; what it negates is decided by the predicate it scopes over.
hz4.semanticModelBefore: Any occurrence of `nobody` / `no one` anywhere in the observation, or `no <person-noun>` followed by any of exposed|present|entered|working|using, asserts employeeExposure=false. Generic negation words are interchangeable. No notion of predicate, restrictor, or sense.
hz4.semanticModelAfter: A negative person quantifier scopes over a clause. The restrictive modifier is skipped (the predicate opens at the first finite verb), then the predicate is classified into exactly one of four senses by the EARLIEST family marker it contains: PRESENCE_OR_EXPOSURE, CONTROL_USE, OUTCOME, UNRESOLVED. ONLY PRESENCE_OR_EXPOSURE asserts employeeExposure=false. Nothing asserts the converse: the repair removes a false claim and does not invent employeeExposure=true, because the §298 sentence is vacuously true if nobody is up there and deterministic code must not author a safety semantic it cannot establish.
hz4.quantifierFormsRecognised: nobody | no one | no-one | no <person-noun>(s) | none of the <person-noun>(s) | not a single <person-noun>. The last two were invisible to the pre-§299 expression.

regressionFamily.whyBothCountsMatter: The family measures a DISTINCTION, not a direction. A repair that simply stopped negating exposure would fail the 10 that must still negate; a repair that changed nothing would fail the 16 the old expression got wrong.
regressionFamily.preSection299WasWrongInBothDirections: It also MISSED genuine exposure denials — 'Not a single employee was exposed', 'No employees on the elevated surface', 'None of the crew were on the roof' — so genuine no-exposure handling is improved as well as narrowed.
regressionFamily.gapTheFamilyCaughtDuringDevelopment: Plural control nouns: 'No employees working in the trench were wearing respirators' classified UNRESOLVED because the marker list is singular. Repaired by an optional plural suffix in the matcher, not by adding the plural to the list.

hz4ProductionEvidence.whyNot: POST /hazlenz/classify is guarded by JwtGuard + EntitlementGuard(fullSafeScope) + RolesGuard. Exercising it in production would require creating a synthetic production account and granting it an entitlement — production writes §299 did not authorise. Two non-invasive alternatives were attempted and both require an owner action: `render ssh` into the running container needs a TTY and, underneath, an SSH public key registered with the Render account; and no production database credential is available locally, so the §298 synthetic account's password could not be reset the way §298 reset it.
hz4ProductionEvidence.doNotRead: This must NOT be read as 'HZ-4 is verified live in production'. The local half is executed and complete — 89 + 13 + 15 assertions through the shipped buildEvidenceFacts() and applyEvidenceFoundation() — and the production half is an identity argument about which bytes are running. The two are different strengths of claim and are recorded as such.
hz4ProductionEvidence.howToClose: One authenticated POST /hazlenz/classify in production carrying the §298 observation text, asserting that 29 CFR 1910.28 comes back UNKNOWN with 'employee access or exposure' in missingPredicates rather than CONTRADICTED. It needs an account with fullSafeScope and it creates no Expert analysis and spends nothing. Requires product-owner authorisation for the production account, or an SSH key on the Render service for a read-only in-container probe.
